lockup.summary: Directors, executive officers and existing shareholders cannot sell shares for 180 days from the date of the prospectus. The shareholders selling in this offering are exempt for the shares they sell.

what: It provides education technology and STEAM learning products and services to primary and secondary schools in Hong Kong.
proceeds: It expects about $7.0 million in net proceeds. It plans to spend 30% on research and development, 20% each on improving operations, expanding into ASEAN and the Middle East, and working capital, and 10% on sales and marketing.
risks: Public school customers rely on Hong Kong government STEAM subsidies, so any cut or delay in those subsidies could hurt the company.
Schools can apply for subsidies only after a school term ends, so revenue and cash flow can swing sharply through the year.
It depends on its non-exclusive LEGO Education reseller deal, which either side can end with three months' notice.
New laws on for-profit education providers could raise its costs and restrict its operations.
Accidents with tools or model rocket engines during model-building activities could injure users, harm its reputation and lead to lawsuits.
